text: {"reply":"Hi {first_name}, thank you for your message. Your TSH result was 2.1 mIU/L. The lab's usual range is 0.4 to 4, so your number falls inside that range. Whether your dose is right for you is a question for your clinician. They can talk with you about what this result means for you and will advise if any change is needed. Please keep taking your medicine as you have been. If you have new or worse symptoms, you can book a visit or call the clinic."}
